from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual')
patterns=[r'kopf-schicht',r'koerper-schicht',r'pupillen-glow',r'augen-blink',r'mund-effekt',r'kopf-dreh',r'requestAnimationFrame',r'setInterval',r'setTimeout',r'gier',r'nick',r'roll',r'schulter',r'atm',r'breath',r'neutral',r'zero',r'opacity',r'transform']

 seen=set()
 for i in hits:
